summary: A retail-focused day with inflation pressures and supply chain impacts. Retail inflation expected to spike to 5.47% in September driven by food prices, while aluminum squeeze pushes Diet Coke to Rs 70/can; separately, industrial/warehousing leasing hits record 59.1 mn sq ft Jan-Sep.

bullets.text: Retail inflation projected to rise to 5.47% in September from 4.82% in August, driven by food price increases: Union Bank of India.
Diet Coke price increased to Rs 70 per can in Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Goa due to aluminum cost squeeze.
Industrial/warehousing space leasing hit record 59.1 million sq ft across top 24 cities in Jan-Sep 2024.
Nat Habit raised Rs 142 crore Series C funding to expand manufacturing capacity 5x and reach 2 lakh retail stores.
Jio Platforms targets $106 billion valuation in planned IPO launch on October 21.
